run_boost_libpng_test: run the Boost.Build libpng test script to verify static and shared library linking with the mock toolset
review_boostbuild_tester: review the BoostBuild.Tester usage for setting up a mock toolset test harness with custom arguments
test_mocktoolset_expected_actions: test the MockToolset.set_expected method to verify compiler and linker actions for libpng builds
run_build_system_link_static: run the build system with link=static to test static library compilation and archiving of libpng source
run_build_system_link_shared: run the build system with link=shared to test shared library DLL compilation of libpng source
